parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: This is one leg of the pliers, made of steel, forming one of the two handles and jaws of the tool.
parts.Functional_description: It provides leverage and transmits force from the user's hand to the gripping jaws, enabling cutting or holding actions.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint relative to the other leg to open and close the jaws.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the pliers, made of steel, containing the pivot joint and the opposite leg.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main structural component, housing the pivot and providing the opposing jaw and handle for gripping or cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed relative to the pivot while the other leg moves to perform the gripping or cutting action.
